evidence_summary: Approved after cabal build all, cabal test watcher-core-test, git diff --check, git diff --cached --check, tracked/untracked scope inspection, and source-backed review of moifold.cabal, the new identity contract, README diff, package extraction readiness, API freeze, project contract, and release-gate limits. The round is artifact-only and does not change Cabal files, Haskell source, tests, generated fixtures, release notes, changelogs, compatibility facades, source layout, package descriptors, or publication state.
